import json, csv

fields = {{fields}}
with open('{{in_jsonl}}') as fi, open('{{out_csv}}','w', newline='') as fo:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(fo, fieldnames=fields)
    writer.writeheader()
    for line in fi:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line: continue
        obj = json.loads(line)
        writer.writerow({k: obj.get(k, '') for k in fields})
print('done -> {{out_csv}}')
